info.title: Agentum EU & US Entity Resolver API
info.description: Deterministic EU & US corporate entity resolution, EU VIES VAT validation, and OFAC/EU sanctions screening for autonomous AI agents. Supports HTTP 402 via Coinbase x402 v2 and Stripe/Tempo MPP.

post.summary: Resolve legal entity by identifier or name
post.description: Resolves companies and organizations across global registers (GLEIF, EU VAT, SEC EDGAR, State Registrars) with optional sanctions screening and live VAT verification.

query.description: Company name, LEI, EU VAT, LT JAR code, US CIK/EIN, or domain

jurisdiction.description: Optional ISO country or region filter (e.g. 'EU', 'US', 'LT', 'DE')

verifyVat.description: Verify EU VAT number against live VIES if available

includeParent.description: Include parent and ultimate parent LEI relationships

checkSanctions.description: Cross-screen entity against OFAC SDN & EU Financial Sanctions (default true)

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers

post.summary: Verify EU VAT registration status via VIES
post.description: Validates European Union VAT identification numbers against the live official EU VIES system, linking against known company profiles.

vatNumber.description: EU VAT number including 2-letter country prefix (e.g. 'LT100004278519')

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers

post.summary: Screen entity or individual against global sanctions lists
post.description: Performs fuzzy and exact sanctions screening against OFAC SDN and EU Financial Sanctions with configurable similarity thresholds.

name.description: Entity or individual name to screen

registrationNumber.description: Optional company registration, LEI, or tax ID

402.description: Payment Required — returns PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402 v2) and WWW-Authenticate: Payment (Stripe/Tempo MPP) headers
